description: Implement a secure JWT authentication module using refresh tokens.
recommendation: All engineering gates passed. Ready for human review and approval.

result.response:
Implementation Plan

Key files to create/modify
- config/security.{yml|json|env}: JWT secrets/keys, expiries, cookie flags.
- src/models/User.{ts|py|rb}: Ensure auth fields (password hash, status).
- src/models/RefreshToken.{ts|py|rb}: DB entity with userId, tokenHash, expiresAt, revokedAt, fingerprint/device.
- db/migrations/*: Create RefreshToken table and indexes.
- src/utils/jwt.ts: Sign/verify access/refresh tokens, key rotation support.
- src/services/authService.ts: Login, logout, refresh, rotate tokens, revoke, reuse detection.
- src/middleware/authMiddleware.ts: Access token verification, attach user/context.
- src/controllers/authController.ts: Endpoints: /login, /refresh, /logout, /revoke-all.
- src/routes/authRoutes.ts: Route bindings and rate limits.
- src/security/csrf.ts (if cookies): CSRF protection for refresh endpoint.
- tests/integration/auth.* and tests/unit/*: Happy paths, rotation, reuse, revocation.
- docs/auth.md: Flows, token lifetimes, error codes.

Primary design decisions
- RS256 with private/public keys; short-lived access (5–15m), longer refresh (7–30d).
- Store only hashed refresh tokens; rotate on every refresh; revoke on reuse.
- Bind refresh tokens to device fingerprint and IP range; limit active sessions per user.
- Deliver refresh via HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie; access via Authorization header.
- Implement logout (revoke current) and global revoke (all sessions).
- Add key rotation (kid) and clock skew tolerance.

Risks
- Token theft/replay; mitigate with rotation, reuse detection, device binding.
- CSRF if using cookies; enforce SameSite/CSRF tokens.
- Key leakage/rotation errors; strict key management.
- Concurrency race during rotation; use transactional updates/unique constraints.
- Performance of token lookups; add indexes and caching judiciously.
